test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**Myght**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the word in option 3 is incorrectly spelled.**
 
• "Myght" is an incorrect spelling and should be avoided in written communication.
 
• **The correct spelling is "Might" with the letter "i".**
 
 
• **​"Might" is used for saying that something is possible.** (किसी बात की ‘संभावना’ का अर्थ व्‍यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त)
 
• Or it also means great strength or power. (प्रचुर बल या शक्ति)
 
 
• Example: He is a mighty elephant. Or It might rain today.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (Nurture) means to care for and encourage the growth or development of something or someone.(पालन ​​पोषण)
 
• Option 2 (Knight) refers to a medieval warrior who was trained to fight on horseback.(सामंत)
 
• Option 4 (Nature) refers to the physical world and its phenomena, including plants, animals, and landscapes.(प्रकृति)
